inputs.style: Urgent instrumental fantasy science-fiction boss battle, 128 BPM, D minor. Low bowed strings, tightly gated analog bass, snare and deep tom polyrhythms, sharp brass stabs and bright plucked synth counterpoint. Menacing but adventurous. Clearly articulated musical instruments, controlled sub-bass, rhythmic tension without harsh high frequencies. Original video game instrumental score. Only musical instruments. No vocals, no singing, no speech, no choir, no humming, no vocal samples. Clear melodic phrases, restrained dynamics, spacious clean production, gentle high frequencies, controlled bass, seamless flowing arrangement.
inputs.lyrics:
[Instrumental warning: low strings and a short drum pickup]
[Instrumental assault: driving bass pulse and brass response]
[Instrumental escalation: bright arpeggio above interlocking string rhythms]
[Instrumental resolve: return to the main rhythmic motif]
